crossRefs.note: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
“Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

translations.web: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
translations.bsb: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
translations.kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
translations.asv: Behold thou their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their song.
